svg.title: Frog dealer - fail expression overlay (tongue out)
svg.desc:
Transparent overlay for frog_base.svg. Contains ONLY the protruding tongue. Same 1024x1024 coordinate space as the base, composited at identical size with zero offset.
The tongue's top edge is the exact sub-curve t=0.38..0.62 of the base's mouth cubic (318,516) C (364,612) (660,612) (706,516), i.e. (451.30, 583.86) C (490.61, 589.39) (533.39, 589.39) (572.70, 583.86) so the root seats on the mouth line instead of floating near it. Base width 121px against a 600px-wide head. The tongue droops to y=722, clearing the base's chin (y=674) by ~48px, and leans ~16px right of centre for the mocking, lopsided read.
